tasks.short: Monitor sewing machine operation for defects

steps.what: Monitor machine operation for defective stitching, thread breaks and malfunctions

tasks.design: Keep direct sewing observation and stop decisions with the operator. Existing controls on {OTHER}, the sewing machine, remain in use without a new vision or model layer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Defective stitching and fabric behaviour require direct observation during handling.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported software change in the digest removes this observation.
tasks.still_hard: A machine can run while producing a defective seam.
tasks.human_edge: Notice subtle changes in stitching, fabric feed and machine sound.
tasks.altitude: Monitoring time and stop authority remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Fault symptoms and safe stop procedures

evidence.claim: Direct stitch and machine observation retains all labour; the digest's cutting and production-record tools do not establish sewing defect detection.

assumptions: Boundary is detecting problems and deciding to stop or seek assistance; repair and rework are separate tasks.
No automated step consumes a new defect flag or classification.
Existing native machine controls remain unchanged. No new deployment or ongoing upkeep is introduced, justifying zero.
unknowns: Machine safeguards and operator monitoring duties
research_questions: Which recurring stitch problems require maintenance rather than operator adjustment?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; zero gross saving and zero upkeep. Existing machine runtime earns no labour saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select thread and fasteners for the job

steps.what: Read job requirements for thread, fasteners and other supplies
Select supplies and check their match to the job requirements

tasks.design: Retain specification reading and physical supply selection with the operator. Existing job references in {DOCS} support checking colour, size, strength and compatibility.
tasks.previous_blocker: Labels alone may not establish the physical suitability of thread or fasteners.
tasks.enabler_now: No new system is required for the retained selection process.
tasks.still_hard: Subtle colour differences and material condition need direct inspection.
tasks.human_edge: Choose supplies that meet both the written requirement and the actual material needs.
tasks.altitude: Supply selection responsibilities and time remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Approved alternatives and material acceptance criteria

evidence.claim: Physical supply matching retains its labour; no unobserved material lookup or stock-entry baseline is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is understanding requirements and selecting supplies, excluding purchasing and physical machine setup.
The production planner supplies existing job specifications. No new structured colour or compatibility code is required by an automated step.
Use existing native job references. No new deployment or upkeep is added, so incremental work is zero.
research_questions: Which supply mismatches are not detectable from existing references?

already_counted.description: Requirement reading and physical supply matching

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; zero gross and net saving. Reading and physical selection are retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Establish processed material quantities and identify the job
Copy processed quantities from the job card into the production register
Check the recorded quantities and correct discrepancies

tasks.design: Capture verified quantities once in a native {OPS_SYSTEM} job form and map them into the production register. Retain physical counting, reject classification and final discrepancy checks; machine stitch counts are not assumed to equal finished material quantities.
tasks.previous_blocker: Paper job cards or local records may be copied into a separate production register.
tasks.enabler_now: A fixed job-and-quantity form can feed the required register without repeated typing.
tasks.still_hard: Partial bundles, rejects and rework need correct physical interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: Ensure that recorded quantities describe actual processed materials rather than machine activity.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate recording where it exists; counting and accountability remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Units, reject treatment and job completion rules

evidence.claim: Valia Furniture includes order processing and production dashboards; it supports the production-record category without proving automatic sewing quantity capture.
One-time operator capture and removal of duplicate register entry is an E1 sewing-workflow scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is establishing and recording processed quantities, excluding live defect monitoring, material selection and planner reconciliation.

The sewing machine operator produces job ID, material ID, unit, quantity, reject or rework designation and timestamp in s1. All 45 hours remain for physical counting, classification and form entry. Unknown units or job IDs require manual clarification in s1 and s3.
s2 consumes those verified fields through a fixed native mapping. Existing device counters are used only if already validated for the same unit; their runtime earns no saving.
Test native job forms and register exports before custom integration. The scenario requires a real duplicate-entry baseline; a single-entry plant gains nothing from this mapping.
unknowns: Current duplicate entry and register requirements
Units used for partial materials and rework
research_questions: Does one-time capture remove copying without lengthening physical quantity establishment or discrepancy checks?

incremental.description: Maintain job mappings and resolve posting faults

approvals.approved_version: Exact job, material, unit, quantity, reject treatment and timestamp version; corrections void confirmation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=45+0+20=65; gross 35%, minus four focal upkeep gives 31% central net. Low assumes only ten duplicate-entry hours removable with unchanged physical capture and checking.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Remove duplicate quantity transcription where present while retaining sewing observation and material selection.
reach: Agree quantity units and rework handling with production planners
role.ambitious_version: A sewing operator who copies fewer quantities and retains full attention to material and stitch quality.
